services.label: Website Building
services.tagline: A fast, professional website built specifically for your business and your customers in {{city}}.
services.whatWeDo: We start with a detailed brief — your goals, your services, your brand. From there we design and build your website, review it with you, and launch it live. Built to load fast, look professional on mobile, and convert visitors into enquiries.
deliverables: Live website — mobile optimised and fast loading
Basic on-page SEO in place from day one
whatWeNeed: Photos of your business (or we guide you on what to take)

services.label: GMB Optimization
services.tagline: Your Google Business Profile, fully set up and actively working to bring you local customers every day.
services.whatWeDo: Most businesses set up their Google Business Profile once and forget it. We treat it as an active marketing channel — optimised categories, regular posts, photo strategy, review management, Q&A setup. A properly managed GMB profile is one of the most cost-effective ways to get local leads.
services.timeline: Setup complete in week 1. Results visible in 30–60 days.
whatWeNeed: Any existing customer reviews to work with

services.label: SEO
services.tagline: Getting your website to rank when people in {{city}} search for {{niche}} services — so they find you instead of your competitors.
services.whatWeDo: SEO is a long game but it compounds over time. We start with a full technical audit of your website, identify what's blocking it from ranking, fix it, then build on top of it — keyword targeting, on-page content, local SEO signals, and monthly rank tracking. We report every month on exactly where you rank and what moved.
deliverables: Local SEO setup (city and niche signals)
Google Search Console and Analytics access shared with you
services.timeline: First movements visible in 60–90 days. Significant results in 4–6 months.

services.label: Google Ads Management
services.tagline: Your business at the top of Google the moment someone in {{city}} searches for {{niche}} — from day one.
services.whatWeDo: While SEO builds long-term visibility, Google Ads gets you leads immediately. We handle everything — campaign structure, keyword selection, ad copy, bid management, daily monitoring, and monthly optimization. You get a weekly performance summary and a detailed monthly report.

services.label: Meta Ads Management
services.tagline: Reaching your ideal customer in {{city}} on Facebook and Instagram — before they even know they need you.
services.whatWeDo: Meta Ads work differently from Google Ads — instead of reaching people who are already searching, we reach people who match your ideal customer profile while they're browsing. This works especially well for visual services and for building brand recognition in your local market. We handle campaign strategy, audience building, creative direction, ad copy, and optimisation.
services.timeline: Campaigns live within 5–7 days. Results typically visible in 2–3 weeks.
whatWeNeed: Monthly ad budget (your own spend — we manage it)
Brand photos or videos for creatives

services.label: WhatsApp Marketing
services.tagline: Staying connected with your leads and customers through the channel they actually respond to.
services.whatWeDo: WhatsApp has the highest open rate of any marketing channel in India — most messages are read within minutes. We set up your WhatsApp Business API, build approved message templates, and run monthly broadcast campaigns to your customer list. We also build automated follow-up sequences so leads don't fall through the cracks.
deliverables: WhatsApp Business API setup and verification
services.timeline: Setup complete in week 1–2. First campaign within 2 weeks of setup.
whatWeNeed: Dedicated business phone number for WhatsApp

services.label: AI Automations
services.tagline: Taking the repetitive work out of running your business — so you can focus on what actually grows it.
services.whatWeDo: We identify the highest-impact automation opportunities in your business — enquiry handling, follow-ups, appointment reminders, report generation, internal workflows — and build them using AI. Each automation is built to your specific workflow, tested, deployed, and maintained. You save time, reduce errors, and your business runs smarter.
services.timeline: Discovery in week 1. First automation deployed within 2–3 weeks.
whatWeNeed: Access to the tools and platforms you currently use
